fields.label: Accepted IC Certificate Types
fields.description: One certificate type per line, as entered on staff certificates. A valid certificate of these types counts as trained for full-time staff, committee members and network members.

fields.label: Patient Identifier Retention (Months)
fields.description: Leave empty until the hospital decides. Identifiers older than this are removed; totals stay.

fields.label: Exposure Record Retention (Months)
fields.description: Leave empty until the hospital decides.

fields.label: Report Within (Hours)
fields.description: Exposures reported later than this are flagged as late. Leave empty to flag none.

fields.label: Start Prophylaxis Within (Hours)
fields.description: Prophylaxis started later than this is flagged as late. Leave empty to flag none.

fields.label: Census Reminder Time
fields.description: After this time, inpatient wards without yesterday's census are reminded. Default 10:00.

fields.label: Bundle Check Reminder Time
fields.description: After this time, open device episodes without a posted prevention bundle audit today are reminded. Default 10:00.

fields.label: Committee Report Working Day
fields.description: The monthly one-page report for the infection control committee is generated at 07:00 on this working day of the month (Monday to Friday, holidays excluded). Default 5.

fields.label: Prophylaxis On Time Within (Minutes before Incision)
fields.description: Antibiotic prophylaxis given from 0 to this many minutes before the incision is on time, following the hospital protocol. Leave empty to assess none. A change recalculates surgeries of unlocked periods only.

name: IC Program Settings
description: Infection control program settings: planned beds and facility level decide the required IC structure.
